input:
/app/app.db is a schema version 1 SQLite database created from /app/schema_v1.sql. Write the migration /app/migrations/002_users_v2.sql and apply it to /app/app.db with `sqlite3 /app/app.db < /app/migrations/002_users_v2.sql`. The file must be plain SQL that upgrades ANY version 1 database (it will also be run against other v1 databases with different rows).

Version 2:
- users has exactly the columns (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT NOT NULL, last_name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, signup_date TEXT NOT NULL), in that order, keeping user ids.
- From full_name with surrounding spaces trimmed: first_name is the text before the first space, last_name the rest with surrounding spaces trimmed ('' when there is no space).
- email is trimmed and lowercased. Users whose emails are equal after that are merged: keep only the lowest id, and orders of the removed users now belong to the kept user.
- signup (MM/DD/YYYY) becomes signup_date YYYY-MM-DD.
- meta schema_version is '2'.
orders keeps its columns and rows (only user_id may change).

transcript.final_response: Created `/app/migrations/002_users_v2.sql` and applied it to `/app/app.db`. The migration keeps the lowest ID for normalized duplicate emails, reassigns their orders, converts the user fields, and updates `schema_version` to `2`.
tool_calls: ls -l /app && cat /app/schema_v1.sql && sqlite3 /app/app.db '.schema' && sqlite3 /app/app.db 'select * from users; select * from orders; select * from meta;'

mkdir -p /app/migrations
cat > /app/migrations/002_users_v2.sql <<'SQL'
BEGIN TRANSACTION;

-- Redirect every order to the lowest-id user in its normalized-email group.
UPDATE orders
SET user_id = COALESCE(
    (
        SELECT MIN(other.id)
        FROM users AS original
        JOIN users AS other
          ON lower(trim(other.email)) = lower(trim(original.email))
        WHERE original.id = orders.user_id
    ),
    user_id
);

ALTER TABLE users RENAME TO users_v1;

CREATE TABLE users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    first_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    signup_date TEXT NOT NULL
);

INSERT INTO users (id, first_name, last_name, email, signup_date)
SELECT
    id,
    CASE
        WHEN instr(trim(full_name), ' ') = 0 THEN trim(full_name)
        ELSE substr(trim(full_name), 1, instr(trim(full_name), ' ') - 1)
    END,
    CASE
        WHEN instr(trim(full_name), ' ') = 0 THEN ''
        ELSE trim(substr(trim(full_name), instr(trim(full_name), ' ') + 1))
    END,
    lower(trim(email)),
    substr(signup, 7, 4) || '-' || substr(signup, 1, 2) || '-' || substr(signup, 4, 2)
FROM users_v1 AS u
WHERE id = (
    SELECT MIN(other.id)
    FROM users_v1 AS other
    WHERE lower(trim(other.email)) = lower(trim(u.email))
);

DROP TABLE users_v1;

UPDATE meta SET value = '2' WHERE key = 'schema_version';

COMMIT;
SQL
sqlite3 /app/app.db < /app/migrations/002_users_v2.sql
sqlite3 /app/app.db '.schema users' '.schema orders' 'select * from users order by id;' 'select * from orders order by id;' 'select * from meta;'
